title: Sintel

characters.name: Sintel
characters.label: the red-haired traveler
characters.look: A lean young woman with short reddish hair, dressed in cold-weather travel rags and leaning on a staff.

characters.label: the mountain warrior
characters.look: A muscular bald man with a dark goatee and thin mustache, wielding a spear in the snowy mountains.

characters.label: the old shaman
characters.look: An elderly bearded man wearing a patterned headscarf, facial piercings, and earth-toned robes, smoking a pipe.

characters.name: Scales
characters.label: the baby dragon
characters.look: A small, sandy-brown reptilian dragon fledgling with small horns, bat-like wings, and expressive eyes.

characters.label: the adult dragon
characters.look: A massive, winged reptilian dragon with pale brownish scales, curved horns, and immense claws.

scenes.summary: A red-haired traveler plods through deep snow amid towering frozen mountain peaks.

facts.text: The traveler carries a staff while trekking through severe snowstorms.
She lowers her scarf, revealing a tired and determined young face.

scenes.summary: A bald mountain warrior leaps from above and attacks the traveler, knocking her unconscious before dragging her away.

facts.text: A warrior wielding a spear ambushes the traveler from the cliffs.
The warrior overpowers her and strikes her down onto the snow.
The traveler loses consciousness as the warrior looms over her.
The warrior drags her by her staff across the snow toward a distant shelter.

scenes.summary: The traveler wakes inside a warm yurt where an old shaman serves her hot soup and learns she is hunting a dragon.

facts.text: The shaman notes that the traveler's blade has shed much innocent blood.
The shaman offers warm broth to help the traveler recover.
She explains that she has ventured into the land of the gatekeepers to search for someone.
She clarifies to the shaman that the one she is searching for is a dragon.

scenes.summary: In a flashback to her past, the red-haired girl searches for food in a city alley and discovers an injured baby dragon on a rooftop.

facts.text: The red-haired girl rummages through discarded crates and alley scraps.
She climbs onto a tiled rooftop after hearing a distressed cry.
She discovers a small baby dragon with a severely bleeding wing.
The baby dragon relaxes and permits the girl to gently touch its snout.

scenes.summary: The girl cleans and bandages the fledgling dragon's injured wing, names him Scales, and sleeps beside him.

facts.text: The girl tends to the wounded creature in her makeshift ruined room.
The girl names the baby dragon Scales as she tucks him into bed.
Scales wakes her up affectionately the next morning by tugging her sleeve.

scenes.summary: The girl and Scales chase a chicken through busy streets and market stalls, showing off their playful bond.

facts.text: The girl encourages Scales as they sprint together through town.
Scales proudly emits a small puff of fire into the air.
Scales gazes upward at a flock of birds flying high overhead.

scenes.summary: After climbing high ruins above the city, Scales attempts to fly, only to be captured by a giant dragon that swoops away.

facts.text: The girl and Scales climb the stone stairs to the summit of the ruined temple overlooking the city.
Scales glides into the open sky as the girl cheers him on.
A massive adult dragon dives from the sky and grabs Scales in its talons.
The girl watches her dragon friend carried away into the horizon and resolves to find him.

scenes.summary: The girl embarks on a long, arduous trek across dead forests, vast deserts, bamboo thickets, and rocky canyons.

facts.text: She traverses endless desert dunes alone.
She navigates dense bamboo groves while tracking her lost companion.
She wrestles and defeats a savage creature among desert rock formations.

scenes.summary: Her journey leads her into the blizzard-swept mountains, bringing the story back to the opening ambush.

facts.text: She braves freezing blizzards and steep rock faces in the snowy ranges.
Ambushers watch her from above as she walks below them in the snow.

scenes.summary: Back in the present, the girl weeps over her failure, but the shaman returns her blade and reassures her that she is close.

facts.text: The girl weeps, believing she has failed her quest.
The shaman reveals her name as Sintel and tells her she is already in dragon lands.
Sintel's staff-blade features an emblem depicting a great tree.

scenes.summary: Sintel discovers a lone tree matching the blade's emblem above a cavern and enters the dark, glowing depths.

facts.text: Sintel finds the exact tree depicted on her weapon's crest.
She enters an enormous dark cavern dotted with luminous crystal clusters.
She spots an enormous dragon feeding on a carcass in the distance.
She discovers what appears to be a small baby dragon curled asleep on a rock nest.

scenes.summary: The large dragon attacks Sintel with fiery blasts, leading to a desperate duel in which she impales the monster's chest with her spear.

facts.text: The dragon unleashes a massive torrent of flame at Sintel.
Sintel narrowly avoids dragon fire, rolling away and retrieving her staff-spear.
The dragon knocks Sintel to the ground, stunning her.
As the dragon lowers its snout, Sintel strikes upward, driving her spear deep into its heart.

scenes.summary: As the dying dragon collapses, Sintel spots the familiar scar on its wing and realizes in horror that she has slain Scales.

facts.text: Sintel sees a bleeding scar on the dragon's wing identical to the wound she bandaged long ago.
She realizes the dragon she fought was her beloved companion Scales, fully grown over the years of her quest.
Scales dies as glowing embers drift through the cavern.
Tremors shake the cavern as massive stalactites collapse around her.

scenes.summary: Now an elderly woman weathered by decades of searching, Sintel emerges from the collapsed cave and departs as a newborn dragon follows behind.

facts.text: Sintel sits alone at the cliff's edge, visibly aged with graying hair and weathered skin.
She clutches her bruised face, grieving the tragedy of her obsession.
She stands and walks along the sunny mountain ridge toward the horizon.
A tiny baby dragon emerges from behind rocks and follows in her footsteps.

subtitles.text: This blade has a dark past.
It has shed much innocent blood.
You're a fool for traveling alone, so completely unprepared.
You're lucky your blood's still flowing.
What brings you to the land of the gatekeepers?
Someone very dear? A kindred spirit?
A dangerous quest for a lone hunter.
I've been alone for as long as I can remember.
You are closer than you know.

gemini_logline: A lone traveler searching for a lost companion braves treacherous snow-capped mountains and dangerous foes before being rescued by a wise old shaman.
logline: A lone traveller braves the frozen mountains of the gatekeepers, searching for the one thing she has lost.

ad.text: Aerial flyover of jagged snow-covered mountains under a misty sky. On-screen text: The Blender Foundation Presents, The Durian Open Movie Project.
The camera glides over icy peaks and rugged ridges. Text: A Blender Institute Production. This film was supported by The Netherlands Film Fund.
In a vast snowy expanse, Sintel trudges forward with a walking staff, leaving footprints behind.
Hooded and bundled in winter clothes, Sintel walks into the blizzard. She pauses warily as shadowy figures appear on distant snowy rocks.
A mountain warrior leaps down from a crag, swinging a spear. Sintel dodges, parrying his strikes with her staff as they grapple.
The warrior punches Sintel and kicks her into the snow. As he charges with his weapon, she prepares her staff to fight back.
He pins her down. Sintel pulls a dagger from her belt and stabs him in the chest. He collapses.
Sintel lies wounded and exhausted in the snow. Later, far across the snowy plains, a solitary hut glows warmly in the mountain pass.
Her hand slips from her staff in the snow. Sintel continues hiking across the frozen mountain ridge. A title appears: Sintel, with a tree emblem.
Inside a warm tent, fire glows in a pit.
She looks down silently.
Earlier, in a sunlit city, a younger Sintel walks down an alleyway carrying wooden boards. She leans a board against a wall.
She discovers a ripe fruit on a crate, but beside it, finds a prickly hedgehog.
Hearing a noise, she leaps onto a roof. There, a small winged creature lies injured and bleeding on the shingles.
Blood pools from the creature's wing. Sintel crouches down slowly, watching the frightened baby dragon.
She reaches out her hand gently. The baby dragon calms down and nuzzles against her fingers. Sintel smiles softly.
Sintel tends to the dragon's wounded wing, wrapping it with bandages. The baby dragon chirps happily in her lap.
Later that night, Sintel sleeps on a mattress with Scales curled up beside her. The next morning, Scales peeks out from under the blanket.
Scales scampers through the bustling market, chasing after a chicken. Sintel runs after him, laughing as he causes a commotion.
Looking around the street, Sintel pauses. Overhead on a wooden beam, Scales tries to flap his wings and breathes a puff of flame.
Sintel smiles up at him as a flock of birds flies in V-formation across the sky. Later, she runs up crumbling stone stairs.
She reaches the top of the ancient ruins at sunset. Winged creatures soar over the vast city. Sintel cups her hands and cheers enthusiastically.
Scales flies joyfully through the golden evening sky. Sintel watches proudly, but suddenly a giant adult dragon swoops down from above.
The massive dragon snatches Scales with its talons and circles around in the air toward Sintel.
Scales struggles in the dragon's grip, reaching toward Sintel. The huge beast roars, spreads its massive wings, and takes flight.
Sintel stares after them, tears welling in her eyes, her sorrow hardening into resolve.
Sintel sets out on foot. Over days and nights, she treks through barren lands filled with tree stumps under a crescent moon.
As seasons and terrain change, she crosses vast sunbaked desert dunes, shielding her eyes against the glare.
Her journey continues through a dense bamboo forest.
She navigates the thick bamboo stalks, then encounters strange canine beasts in a rocky canyon, fighting them off with her staff.
She climbs steep crags, gazes across canyons, and traverses cold misty hills, clutching her walking stick against the wind.
She presses on up snowy mountain ridges, climbing through freezing gale-force winds and snowstorms.
She slips and scrambles up the snowy slope, marching past rocky formations where shadowed mountain warriors lurk above, watching her every step.
Sensing danger, she turns around just as a warrior ambushes her. Back in the present, inside the tent, Sintel stares into the fire.
The shaman nods quietly.
Sintel touches the round tree emblem engraved on the hilt.
The emblem dissolves into a vision of a grand tree outside a dark cavern. Outside the cave entrance, Sintel looks up in awe.
Sintel enters the cavern. Glowing crystals dot the rock walls. She unslings her bladed staff and moves cautiously forward.
Ahead in a vast subterranean cavern, a dragon tears into a fresh carcass. Sintel ducks behind a rock, observing the beast.
The dragon turns and slithers into a crevice. Sintel peeks around the boulder, gripping her weapon.
Sintel leaps down to the cavern floor and creeps toward a stone basin. Inside lies a small, sleeping baby dragon. Her eyes widen in joy.
The baby dragon opens its eyes and chirps. Suddenly, a massive blast of fire erupts from the side, nearly hitting Sintel.
She dives behind a boulder. The giant adult dragon crawls forward, snarling aggressively.
Sintel rolls away, narrowly dodging fire. She lunges forward, leaps onto the dragon's neck, and stabs her blade into its flesh.
The dragon violently thrashes, hurling Sintel against the rocky ground. She crawls toward her dropped staff as the dragon swings its tail.
Sintel gets struck and knocked down. The dragon swoops down, pinning her underneath its heavy talons. It lowers its massive head.
The dragon sniffs her gently. Sintel breaks free, grabs her blade, and plunges it straight through the dragon's chest.
The dragon reels back in agony. Sintel raises her staff, ready to strike again.
The dragon collapses heavily onto the ground.
Sintel sees a scar on the dragon's wing, matching the wound she bandaged on Scales. In the reflection of blood, she sees her aged reflection.
She looks at her weathered hands in disbelief. Years have passed. The dragon she just killed is Scales.
Sintel collapses to her knees, horrified by what she has done. Scales takes one last breath and closes his eyes.
Sintel weeps over Scales' body. Her cries echo through the cavern, causing stalactites to fall. She runs toward the cave entrance.
Boulders collapse behind her, sealing the cave shut. Outside under the twilight sky, Sintel sits at the edge of the cliff.
Overlooking the mountain range, Sintel sits alone, weeping with her head bowed into her hands.
She raises her tear-streaked face, gazing sadly out into the distant horizon.
Nearby, the small orphaned baby dragon emerges and hops over rocks where snowdrop flowers bloom. Sintel stands up and walks away.
Sintel walks into the glowing sunset along the mountain ridge. The baby dragon waddles behind, following her footsteps.
The baby dragon pauses beside the flowers, then hurries after Sintel as the screen fades to black.
